conclusion: Preliminary single-seed (seed 7) result on mse only: OLS (mse 10.155670419036328) shows lower error than the matched training-mean predictor (mse 23.951894598705938) under 10% test-label outliers of magnitude 10 with clean training data. This is a preliminary report from one seed and one metric; it does not establish general scientific value.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not executed.
Single-seed, single-metric result; no variance or uncertainty estimate.
No claim of general scientific value or generalization beyond this configuration.
